initial_entry_checks.name: Sign in
initial_entry_checks.given: The visitor starts in a fresh unauthenticated browser session. Test setup pre-provisions the verified account `recovery-visibility` with email `recovery-visibility@example.test` and password `Valid-password-123!`; the address `unknown@example.test` does not belong to an account.
initial_entry_checks.when: The visitor opens “Sign in”, clicks “Forgot password”, submits `recovery-visibility@example.test`, and then repeats the reset-step flow for `unknown@example.test`.
